retake.waitBetweenAttempts: You may retest; a knowledge test fee applies on retakes

gdl.permitMinAge: 14 yrs 6 mo (Supervised Instruction Permit; driver training required for under 17)
gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: 6 months on the Supervised Instruction Permit
gdl.nightCurfew: Drivers under 16 may drive only during daylight hours unless accompanied by a licensed driver age 21 or older seated in the front seat
gdl.passengerLimits: For the first 6 months, drivers 16 and under may carry no more than one passenger under 17 (other than family)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
process.realIdNotes: An Idaho Star Card (REAL ID) requires proof of identity/legal presence, proof of Social Security number, and proof of Idaho residency. A standard (non-Star Card) license is also available.
process.permitFee: $20 instruction permit; $21.50 driver-training instruction permit; $5 knowledge test
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in one or both eyes, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12-17 points in 12 months = 30-day suspension; 18-23 in 24 months = 90 days; 24+ in 36 months = 6 months
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 80 mph on some rural interstate segments (posted)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph in a school zone during posted hours
